description: Importation of Eggs as a remedy to the existing egg shortage in the local 	market
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2023-01-02
decision_details_body: - Cabinet decided to import eggs with the intervention of the Government, if necessary, as a solution to the inconvenience faced by the customers due to the current shortage of eggs in the local market and the tendency of hiking the prices of eggs.
